questions.solution: The symbol % means 'how many out of 100'. This is because the percentage represents a part of a whole, where the whole is considered as 100. The option 'how many out of 10' refers to a different measurement, 'how many out of 1000' is associated with a different symbol, and 'how many out of 10000' is not a standard representation.

questions.stem: Rohit bought a book for ₹200 and sold it for ₹240. What is the percentage profit?
questions.solution: Profit = ₹240 - ₹200 = ₹40. Percentage profit = (40/200) × 100 = 20%. The other options are incorrect calculations of the profit percentage.

hi.stem: रोहित ने एक किताब ₹200 में खरीदी और ₹240 में बेच दी। लाभ का प्रतिशत क्या है?
hi.solution: लाभ = ₹240 - ₹200 = ₹40। लाभ का प्रतिशत = (40/200) × 100 = 20%। अन्य विकल्प लाभ के प्रतिशत की गलत गणना है।

questions.stem: In an election, 63% of the voters cast their votes. If the total number of voters is 10,000, how many voters did not cast their votes?
questions.solution: 63% of 10,000 voters cast their votes, which means 6300 voters cast their votes. Therefore, 10,000 - 6300 = 3700 voters did not cast their votes. The other options are incorrect calculations or misinterpretations of the percentage.

hi.solution: 10,000 मतदाताओं में से 63% मतदाताओं ने अपना मत डाला, जिसका अर्थ है कि 6300 मतदाताओं ने अपना मत डाला। अतः 10,000 - 6300 = 3700 मतदाताओं ने अपना मत नहीं डाला। अन्य विकल्प गलत गणना या प्रतिशत के गलत अर्थ के हैं।

questions.stem: If a cricket team played 20 matches and lost 40%, how many matches did it win?
questions.solution: If the team lost 40% of 20 matches, it lost 8 matches. The remaining 12 matches were won. The option '10' is incorrect because it is 50% of 20, not 60%. The option '8' is incorrect because it is 40% of 20, not 60%. The option '6' is incorrect because it is 30% of 20, not 60%.

hi.solution: यदि टीम ने 20 मैचों में 40% हार गई, तो इसने 8 मैच हारे। शेष 12 मैच जीते गए। विकल्प '10' गलत है क्योंकि यह 20 का 50% है, न कि 60%। विकल्प '8' गलत है क्योंकि यह 20 का 40% है, न कि 60%। विकल्प '6' गलत है क्योंकि यह 20 का 30% है, न कि 60%।

questions.stem: What is the percentage of bad sugarcane seedlings if 700 out of 14000 were bad?
questions.solution: To find the percentage of bad sugarcane seedlings, divide the number of bad seedlings by the total number and multiply by 100: (700/14000) × 100 = 5%. The other options do not match this calculation. 70% is too high, 10% and 15% are not the result of dividing 700 by 14000 and multiplying by 100.

hi.solution: खराब गन्ने के बीजों का प्रतिशत ज्ञात करने के लिए खराब बीजों की संख्या को कुल संख्या से विभाजित करें और 100 से गुणा करें: (700/14000) × 100 = 5%। अन्य विकल्प इस गणना के अनुरूप नहीं हैं। 70% बहुत अधिक है, 10% और 15% 700 को 14000 से विभाजित करके और 100 से गुणा करके प्राप्त नहीं होते।

questions.stem: In a class of 50 students, 20 students are boys. What is the percentage of boys in the class?
questions.solution: To find the percentage of boys, divide the number of boys (20) by the total number of students (50) and multiply by 100. This gives 40%. The other options are incorrect because they do not match the calculation.

questions.solution: Fifty percent means 50 per 100, which simplifies to 1/2. The other options do not represent half of a whole. 1/4 is 25%, 1/5 is 20%, and 3/4 is 75%, none of which equal 50%.

questions.stem: If Sameera got 70% marks in an 800 marks exam, how many marks did she get?

questions.stem: If a circle has a radius of 5 cm, what is the length of its diameter?

questions.stem: If the salinity of seawater is 35%, what does this mean?
questions.solution: A salinity of 35% means that 35 parts of salt are present in 100 parts of seawater. This reflects the standard way percentages are used to express concentration. The other options use incorrect ratios that do not match the definition of a percentage.

questions.stem: If the radius of a circle is 7 cm, what is the circumference of the circle?
questions.solution: The formula for the circumference of a circle is 2πr. Using π as 22/7 and r as 7 cm, the circumference is 44 cm. The other options do not correctly apply the formula for circumference.

hi.stem: यदि एक वृत्त की त्रिज्या 7 सेमी है, तो वृत्त की परिधि क्या है?
hi.solution: वृत्त की परिधि का सूत्र 2πr है। π के मान 22/7 और r के मान 7 सेमी लेने पर परिधि 44 सेमी होती है। अन्य विकल्प परिधि के सूत्र के सही उपयोग के बजाय गलत हैं।
